analysis:
The PR changes only CI runner labels: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404 becomes ubuntu-24.04 in .github/workflows/register-model.yml (line 95), plus a new timeout-minutes: 30 at line 96. The same swap applies to the `source` job (line 59) and the `publish` job (line 519) in .github/workflows/release-desktop.yml.

The secret-handling controls are unchanged. In register-model.yml, the coordinator URL allowlist step (lines 101-111) still runs before the step that reads MODEL_REGISTRY_PUBLISHING_KEY (lines 219-237). In release-desktop.yml, signing and notarization stay on the macOS blacksmith runners (the build, sign, package and sign-dmg jobs, unchanged). The `source` job still checks out master and verifies the source before any credential is used. The `publish` job keeps contents: write and still downloads artifacts by id and digest, then checks SHA256SUMS.

Moving the Ubuntu jobs to GitHub-hosted ephemeral runners is not a regression. Blacksmith runners are third-party-managed, and the hosted runner narrows the trust surface rather than widening it. The new timeout bounds availability exposure on the registration job. No provider, coordinator, attestation (TB-011) or prefix-cache (T-041) behavior is touched. I cannot see repository-level settings, such as whether the hosted runner is protected by environment or branch rules, so those remain unverified. They do not bear on this diff.
